name: @crc/viz
description: Composable Canvas data visualization for CRC
author: Ben Lesh <ben@benlesh.com>

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=esnext --sourcemap --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --external:@crc/core --external:@crc/core/internal
